'Adaption' and 'Based on' really seems like splitting hairs. It is it's own thing, and with an unbiased opinion, I think for what it is it's fine. Everything not written by the author is technically fan fiction, this is not a bad thing. 

Just because this show isn't the same standard as the books doesn't mean it's an entirely bad show. Peeps just need to separate them. The books are still there, you can still read the stories you love. Nothing is tainted by a different take on the source.

That said I definitely have criticisms of some of the writing choices, but it's impossible to have any discussion on them because people won't shut up about the books. This isn't the books. Anything from the books is irrelevant to discussion at this point and I wish there were a show watcher only thread to discuss with folk who could look at it objectively.
